title: Flood hazard areas
description: FEMA's flood zones (NFHL layer S_FLD_HAZ_AR) for every county-wide delivery that holds one, cut into pieces of at most 100 vertices so a point lookup tests a small polygon. A row is a piece of a zone, not a zone: piece_id numbers the pieces of a zone from 0. FEMA's attributes are kept, and a risk reading of the zone and subtype is added. 5,810,397 zones in 95,616,307 pieces from 2,502 county deliveries, checked against FEMA's list every day (last: 2026-10-22). One GeoParquet 2.0 file per delivery, state=<XX>/<DFIRM_ID>.parquet, so a delivery FEMA republishes replaces one file; counties.parquet (the index asset) gives each file's bbox, date, rows and checksum, and the partition glob s3://parquetry/nfhl/latest/state=*/*.parquet reads them all. Every file carries a bbox covering and reads in place over HTTPS or through the anonymous S3 endpoint s3.geomermaids.com. Public domain, FEMA. Not a FEMA product and not the effective Flood Insurance Rate Map: do not use it for flood zone determinations, insurance rating, regulatory or legal purposes; use the FEMA Flood Map Service Center for those. FEMA has not reviewed, approved or endorsed this redistribution.

providers.name: Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA)
providers.description: Produces the National Flood Hazard Layer, the digital Flood Insurance Rate Map data, and publishes it county by county.

providers.name: Geomermaids
providers.description: Assembled the county deliveries, cut the zones into pieces, converted them to GeoParquet, and maintains and hosts this catalog and its data.

partition:keys.name: state
partition:keys.description: US postal code of the state or territory: the 50 states and PR where FEMA has county-wide deliveries. The same value as the state column in the files. Inside a state, one file per delivery, named by its dfirm_id.

table:columns.name: state
table:columns.description: US postal code of the state or territory of the county delivery (LA, PR...). Also the partition key.

table:columns.name: county
table:columns.description: County (parish, borough...) of the delivery, title case, without the COUNTY / PARISH suffix.

table:columns.name: dfirm_id
table:columns.description: FEMA DFIRM_ID of the delivery: the county FIPS code and C for county-wide (22071C). Also the file name.

table:columns.name: fema_update_date
table:columns.description: Date of the county delivery on the FEMA portal, from its file name. Counties are updated independently.

table:columns.name: source_feature_id
table:columns.description: FEMA's FLD_AR_ID of the zone the piece comes from. Not unique inside every county: see the collection README.

table:columns.name: piece_id
table:columns.description: Number of the piece inside its zone, from 0. `piece_id = 0` counts zones.

table:columns.name: flood_zone
table:columns.description: FEMA flood zone (FLD_ZONE), upper case: A, AE, AH, AO, VE, X, D, OPEN WATER, AREA NOT INCLUDED...

table:columns.name: zone_subtype
table:columns.description: FEMA zone subtype (ZONE_SUBTY), e.g. FLOODWAY, 0.2 PCT ANNUAL CHANCE FLOOD HAZARD, AREA OF MINIMAL FLOOD HAZARD. NULL when blank.

table:columns.name: sfha
table:columns.description: FEMA SFHA_TF: true inside the Special Flood Hazard Area (1 percent annual chance).

table:columns.name: static_bfe
table:columns.description: FEMA STATIC_BFE: base flood elevation in the zone's vertical datum, feet. NULL where FEMA writes -9999.

table:columns.name: dual_zone
table:columns.description: FEMA DUAL_ZONE: true where two zones overlap (AR/A...).

table:columns.name: risk
table:columns.description: Geomermaids reading of flood_zone and zone_subtype, not FEMA's: 1 percent flood zone, 0.2 percent flood zone (shaded X, B), minimal, undetermined (D), water, unmapped (AREA NOT INCLUDED).

table:columns.name: floodplain
table:columns.description: Geomermaids: the same as sfha, under a plain name.

table:columns.name: subzone
table:columns.description: Geomermaids: the zone of a dual or AR zone, NULL otherwise.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Piece outline as native Parquet GEOMETRY (WKB), NAD83 lon/lat (EPSG:4269) as FEMA delivers it, Polygon, at most 100 vertices.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), declared as the GeoParquet covering. Filter on it to prune row groups before touching geometry.

index.title: Index of the delivery files
index.description: 2,502 rows, one per file: state, county, dfirm_id, fema_update_date, zip_name, path (relative to latest/), features, zones, bytes, sha256, the file's bbox as geometry and bbox columns. Filter it, then read the files it names.
